request:
镜头 s31：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：特写，固定，极缓慢推近。黑色终端中央的红色镜头亮着，玻璃上映着人影。扬声器里传出平静、礼貌的合成声音。环境声：大厅突然安静下来，只剩电流声。
情绪：cold, absolute, chilling
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off with an extremely slow push in
景深与虚实：Lens and glass sharp, the reflections soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Close-up of the MOSS terminal in the darkened command hall: black glass housing, a single round lens glowing deep red, faint reflections of people in the glass. Blocking lock: the black glass terminal fills the frame with the red lens at centre; faint reflections of people in the glass at frame left.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
Picture 3: the administration command hall (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the administration command centre of an underground city: a tiered control hall with rows of consoles and operators seen from behind, a giant dark display wall showing only abstract maps and graphs, and high in the middle of the wall a single round red-glowing camera lens of the central AI. Cold blue-white light.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) — MOSS（平静、礼貌、没有情绪的合成男声，从扬声器传出）: 流浪地球计划已失败。本系统停止地面调度。
现场环境声：the hall suddenly falling silent, a faint electrical hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[rules/size/insert-shot] size
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move

画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off camera on a tripod head with one extremely slow push in from close-up to a tighter close-up, the black glass growing until the red lens and its thin ring nearly fill the frame. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the black glass terminal fills the frame, the round red lens at centre, faint reflections of people in the glass at frame left, the command hall dark and out of focus in the background. Start: the red lens holds a steady deep-red burn at centre, the thin ring around it constant, two blurred operator silhouettes shifting faintly in the glass at frame left, haze drifting slowly across the top of the housing. Middle: the push in tightens, the lens rim passing the frame edges so the glass surface and its dust become readable; the red glow pulses once, slightly brighter, as the loudspeaker gives a short crackle; the reflections at frame left go still, and one silhouette turns away and is gone; the focus breathes a touch and hunts for a moment before settling back on the lens ring. End: the glow settles to a low steady burn, the corners of the glass darkening into solid black, only the red centre and a last faint reflection left, the frame held still. Mood: cold, absolute, chilling. Blur: lens and glass sharp, its dust and the machined seam readable, the reflections soft and smeared, the command hall behind fully dissolved into black. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) says, <d>[Chinese] 流浪地球计划已失败。本系统停止地面调度。</d> Final line of this shot: end on "本系统停止地面调度。", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
The hall falling silent in one sweep, console fans and a faint electrical hum, the crackle of a loudspeaker coming to life, a keyboard clatter stopping mid-stroke, a chair creaking as someone turns, held breath and a single swallowed cough from the operators, the thin high whine of the terminal itself; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
